actual_text: The Company posted a March quarter revenue record of $97.3 billion, up 9 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.52.

actual_text: The Company posted a June quarter revenue record of $83.0 billion, up 2 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.20.

actual_text: The Company posted a September quarter record revenue of $90.1 billion, up 8 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.29, up 4 percent year over year.

actual_text: Annual revenue was $394.3 billion, up 8 percent year over year, and annual earnings per diluted share were $6.11, up 9 percent year over year.

actual_text: EX-99.1 2 a8-kex991q1202412302023.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Apple reports first quarter results Services revenue reaches new all-time record EPS up 16 percent to new all-time high CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple ® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2024 first quarter ended December 30, 2023.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q4 2023 — Full Document

actual_text: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $119.6 billion, up 2 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $2.18, up 16 percent year over year.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q4 2023 — Full Document

actual_text: And as customers begin to experience the incredible Apple Vision Pro tomorrow, we are committed as ever to the pursuit of groundbreaking innovation — in line with our values and on behalf of our customers.” “Our December quarter top-line performance combined with margin expansion drove an all-time record EPS of $2.18, up 16 percent from last year,” said Luca Maestri, Apple’s CFO.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q4 2023 — Full Document

actual_text: “During the September quarter, our business performance drove double digit EPS growth and we returned nearly $25 billion to our shareholders, while continuing to invest in our long-term growth plans.” Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.24 per share of the Company’s common stock.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q3 2023 — Full Document

actual_text: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion, up 6 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $0.97.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q3 2024 — Full Document

actual_text: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $124.3 billion, up 4 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $2.40, up 10 percent year over year.
actual_source_label: 8-K Q4 2024 — Full Document

actual_text: Services gross margin was 74%, unchanged from the prior quarter.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024

actual_text: Operating expenses of $14.3 billion were at the midpoint of the guidance range we provided at the beginning of the quarter and up 6% year over year.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024

actual_text: iPhone revenue was $46.2 billion, up 6% year over year and a September quarter record in total and across several markets, including the U.S., the Middle East, Korea, and South Asia.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024

actual_text: We continue to see high levels of customer satisfaction for the iPhone 15 family with 451 Research recently measuring it at 98% in the U.S. Mac revenue was $7.7 billion, up 2% year over year, driven by the strength in MacBook Air.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024

actual_text: And in the latest reports from 451 Research, customer satisfaction was 95% in the U.S. iPad generated $7 billion in revenue, up 8% year over year.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024

actual_text: Also, customer satisfaction was recently measured at 97% in the U.S. Wearables, Home, and Accessories revenue was $9 billion, down 3% year over year.
actual_source_label: AAPL_Q4_2024
